Risk and compliance documentation: LLM systems generating first-draft regulatory submissions, model risk documentation narratives, and compliance reports from structured data inputs. Trade communication compliance: LLM-powered screening of trader communications for policy violations at a fraction of the cost of manual review. Client communication personalization: LLM generating personalized client reporting narratives and market commentary. *All NY financial LLM integrations include FINRA-compliant conversation logging, required disclaimers, and licensed professional escalation.* Cost: $30,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks.
